Introduction

Kim Min Seo is a South Korean singer under Woollim Entertainment. He made his official debut on October 28, 2020 as a member of the boy group DRIPPIN.

When he was a trainee, Minseo participated in the hit reality show Produce X 101 where he finished 52nd place.
